summary: Branch has 2 commits that remove raw token URLs from email_events metadata logging in email-service.ts and add an E2E test to verify this. The core security fix (resetUrl and inviteUrl still stored in DB metadata on main) is genuine and unresolved. However, the security fix commit is mixed with email domain changes (leadflow.ai fallbacks) that conflict with main's subsequent work reverting back to landyourleads.com. Two prior CLOSED PRs (#1358, #1410) targeted the same issue and were never merged, suggesting repeated abandonment. Branch cannot be merged as-is without conflicts; a human must decide whether to isolate and re-apply just the security fix.

risk: medium-high — the underlying security issue (raw reset/invite token URLs stored in email_events DB metadata) is real and unresolved on main. Three separate fix branches have been created (this one + PRs #1358 and #1410) without any being merged, suggesting the fix keeps being abandoned. The branch itself cannot be merged without reintroducing conflicting email domain changes.
recommendation: Human review required. Recommended action: create a fresh, targeted fix task that ONLY removes resetUrl and inviteUrl from the metadata dict in email-service.ts sendPasswordResetEmail() and sendPilotInviteEmail() — without touching email domain constants. The E2E test (tests/0e9cb6bf-token-not-logged-in-email-events.test.js) can be adapted. Once the focused fix is merged, this orphan branch can be safely deleted.
